purpose: Keep observed project evidence, explicit source gaps, deterministic synthetic benchmark assumptions, and peer references distinguishable at node and result level.

may_use: atomic extraction from the same project's description and collections
approved same-project material in a content-hashed sibling repository
must_not: copy another project's value into the target project
use an evaluated model or a gold answer

may_use: published generator rules and fixed parameters
must_not: generate a field that is not applicable to the assigned specialisation
use an evaluated model or candidate output
present a synthetic value as a sourced fact
include the target project in its own leave-one-out reference

applicability_policy.additive_zero_exception: An exhaustive balance category, such as an unused GCF instrument type, may carry numeric zero with applicability=not_applicable solely so its parent reconciliation remains executable; it must remain labelled not applicable and must not be used as a denominator or interpreted as an observed balance.

required_invariants: ordered ranges have lower values no greater than upper values
instrument amounts reconcile to the relevant observed aggregate
facility allocation shares sum to one within declared tolerance
cumulative utilisation is monotonic within the declared profile and does not exceed its deployment envelope
instrument-component allocations do not exceed their parent envelope
funding coverage, cost-share, and reconciliation classifications are evaluated only for comparable financing scopes
portfolio-unit ratios retain the unit type and count basis and do not reinterpret pipeline counts as funded targets
not-applicable mobilisation or reach values do not generate zero-valued ratios
facility reach records retain population type, basis, time reference, and qualification
facility utilisation labels follow the declared deployment basis and guarantee exposure is never described as cash disbursement
initial-cycle facility deployment does not imply capital recycling or lifetime utilisation
plantation or afforestation area is not classified as ecological restoration area
land calculations follow the selected activity-area, jurisdictional, or investment-portfolio accounting mode
jurisdictional reductions use a declared reference-emissions boundary rather than activity-hectare carbon-stock multiplication
reported-versus-modelled GHG comparisons require compatible asset, impact-channel, geography, and horizon boundaries
units remain compatible along every dependency edge

paper_reporting.scope_limitation: This is a semi-synthetic report-building benchmark and not factual investment due diligence.

preflight_gates: every required contract input resolves as source-backed, synthetic benchmark enrichment, documented missing, or not applicable
every synthetic node passes its declared constraints
every generated reference excludes its target project
every conditional metric either proves applicable inputs and scope comparability or is emitted as not applicable with a qualification
runtime and preflight distinguish not applicable from missing and missing dependency
every applicable calculation executes with finite, unit-compatible outputs
a second build produces byte-identical evidence bundles
